title: Stay Add-On Share Stated on the Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
On the annual tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, stay add-ons charged in the window for medication setup, incontinence supplies or one-to-one companion care are stated at an add-on share: where a medication setup add-on was charged the share is 1.0, where only incontinence supplies or companion add-ons were charged the share is 0.5, and otherwise the share is 0.

The share applies to the total of the medication setup, incontinence supplies and one-to-one companion add-on charges in the window, and the add-on portion so obtained is added to the letter's medical expense amount before its single rounding to the cent half up.

## Records read

Add-on charge entries on the resident's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger within the letter's window, by add-on: medication setup, incontinence supplies, one-to-one companion.

## Share ladder

| Add-ons charged in the window | Share |
|---|---|
| A medication setup add-on (with or without others) | 1.0 |
| Only incontinence supplies or one-to-one companion add-ons | 0.5 |
| None of these | 0 |

## Hypothetical windows

| Medication setup | Incontinence supplies | One-to-one companion | Share | Add-on portion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 150.00 | 80.00 | 0.00 | 1.0 | 230.00 |
| 0.00 | 80.00 | 300.00 | 0.5 | 190.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
